Tumakuru.desc: Sources told *Moneycontrol* that the proposed rail corridors are: Bengaluru–Hoskote–Kolar (65 km), Bengaluru–Mysuru (145 km), Bengaluru–Tumakuru (60 km). The proposal highlights the untapped economic potential of cities such as Kolar, Mysuru, Tumakur

Baba Budangiri.desc: Baba Budangiri, also known as Chandradrona, is a hill and mountain range in the Western Ghats of India, located in the Chikkamagaluru district of Karnataka.

Hebbe Falls.desc: Chikmagalur's largest waterfall. Private vehicles are not allowed past Kemmangundi — the only way in is the jeep ride (around ₹590 per person) through the forest, followed by a short trek to the falls. (sourced from r/SoloTravel_India and r/karnataka)
